sa_sajta.opis: Paket Alua Boccaccio - Majorka - Port d'Alcúdia
sa_sajta.tekst:
Situated just 100 metres from the beach, adjacent to the Lago Esperanza lake, the hotel is ideal for fishing and those with an interest in sports, because it has direct access to the beach where one can practice several sports.
Guests can feel at home in one of the 288 rooms. A lobby and a reception are available to travellers. The upper floors of the complex can be accessed by lift. Services and facilities at the hotel include a restaurant, a dining area, a café, a bar, a TV room, room service and a fax machine. Wireless internet access is available to guests. The grounds of the hotel feature a playground and an attractive garden.
Each of the rooms is appointed with air conditioning, central heating and a bathroom. Most rooms feature a balcony with a view for guests' enjoyment. Cots are available for younger travellers. There is also a safe. Additional features include a fridge, a mini fridge and a tea/coffee station. A telephone, a TV and WiFi add to the comfort of the holiday. The accommodation units include a bathroom with a shower. The accommodation offers family rooms, non-smoking rooms and smoking rooms.
The complex features an outdoor pool and a children's pool. A terrace, sun loungers and parasols are available. There is also a poolside snack bar. A variety of sporting activities, such as tennis, beach volleyball and volleyball, or for a fee, biking/mountain biking, are offered at the complex.
